phaseName: Flat Settings and Vibrant App UI
fixes: Flattened Settings sub-pages by removing redundant outer containers while retaining usable input and action boundaries.
Converted Business controls into a clean divider list and compacted Account actions into a two-column layout.
Added stronger screen-specific colors for Home, Business, Sales, Stock and More.
Increased palette saturation and colorful depth in dark and light modes without applying filters to brand images.
Preserved business logic, stored data schema, accounting logic, subscription flows and navigation behavior.
